To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) data is the raw material, (2) information is the product and (3) knowledge is the tool for transforming data to information.

data without interpretation have no meaning and only attain value in the context of information and knowledge, information is a core element in forming new knowledge and new knowledge is essential for the assimilation of and entailing of fresh information with existing knowledge.

(1) data and information are not only the source of knowledge, but also knowledge is the source of information and data; (2) knowledge is not only a product of information, but information is a product of knowledge; (3) data are not only the raw material for information, but information are raw material of data.

we have developed a generic KID model for data-information-knowledge transformation processing, with a focus on the formalization of the concepts of data, knowledge, and information and their interrelations.
the KID model provides a pragmatic and generic framework to understand the interrelations between data, information and information in a knowledge-based context.

the proposed model provides an abstract formalization of data information and knowledge and their interrelations, and provides an abstract formulation of the transformation process from data to information, from information to knowledge and from knowledge to data.
data, information and their relations can be formulated with a generic KID model.
the KID model can be applied in a wide range of domains, such as business and healthcare, for the purpose of knowledge management and information processing.
